  SELECT subject_id FROM module_depends_on_package WHERE object_id='package:fx11-legacy'

)

    SELECT module_id FROM deps WHERE module_id LIKE 'module:fx11-l3-%'

WITH RECURSIVE package_dependents(module_id) AS (
  SELECT subject_id
  FROM module_depends_on_package
  WHERE object_id = 'package:fx11-legacy'
  UNION
  SELECT m.subject_id
  FROM module_depends_on_module m
  JOIN package_dependents pd ON m.object_id = pd.module_id
),
task_ctx AS (
  SELECT trp.subject_id AS task_id,
         trp.object_id AS package_id,
         ttd.object_id AS production_deployment_id
  FROM task_retires_package trp
  JOIN task_targets_deployment ttd ON ttd.subject_id = trp.subject_id
  WHERE trp.subject_id = 'task:fx11-cutover'
    AND trp.object_id = 'package:fx11-legacy'
),
legacy_affected_services AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sim.subject_id AS service_id
  FROM service_implements_module sim
  JOIN package_dependents pd ON sim.object_id = pd.module_id
),
production_scope_services AS (
  SELECT las.service_id
  FROM legacy_affected_services las
  CROSS JOIN task_ctx tc
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM service_deployed_to_deployment sd
    WHERE sd.subject_id = las.service_id
      AND sd.object_id = tc.production_deployment_id
  )
  OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM service_deployed_to_deployment sd2
    JOIN task_ctx tc2 ON sd2.object_id = tc2.production_deployment_id
  )
)
SELECT service_id
FROM production_scope_services pss
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM test_verifies_service tvs WHERE tvs.object_id = pss.service_id
)
ORDER BY service_id

  FROM module_depends_on_module m

),
task_ctx AS (

  FROM task_retires_package trp
  JOIN task_targets_deployment ttd ON ttd.subject_id = trp.subject_id
  WHERE trp.subject_id = 'task:fx11-cutover'
    AND trp.object_id = 'package:fx11-legacy'
),
legacy_affected_services AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sim.subject_id AS service_id
  FROM service_implements_module sim
  JOIN package_dependents pd ON sim.object_id = pd.module_id
),
production_scope_services AS (
  SELECT las.service_id
  FROM legacy_affected_services las
  CROSS JOIN task_ctx tc
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM service_deployed_to_deployment sd
    WHERE sd.subject_id = las.service_id
      AND sd.object_id = tc.production_deployment_id
  )
  OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM service_deployed_to_deployment sd2
    JOIN task_ctx tc2 ON sd2.object_id = tc2.production_deployment_id
  )
),
remaining_affected_services AS (
  SELECT service_id
  FROM production_scope_services pss
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (

)
SELECT DISTINCT deployment_id
FROM (
  SELECT tc.production_deployment_id AS deployment_id FROM task_ctx tc
  UNION
  SELECT sd.object_id AS deployment_id
  FROM service_deployed_to_deployment sd
  JOIN remaining_affected_services ras ON ras.service_id = sd.subject_id
)
ORDER BY deployment_id
